# SeaTalk Link

> Please note that the minimum client version required for SeaTalk Link is 3.40

# Overview

SeaTalk Link is a feature that guides you from within or outside SeaTalk to a specific SeaTalk page.

You can try by clicking the SeaTalk Link of SeaTalk Open Platform Helper:[https://link.seatalk.io/profile/open?seatalk\_id=9348575790.](https://link.seatalk.io/profile/open?seatalk_id=9348575790)

![](data:image/png;base64,)

This link supports redirecting the user to multiple scenarios:

* User/Bot profile page
* Web/RN app page (Coming in the future)
* 1-on-1 chat (Coming in the future)
* Group chat (Coming in the future)
* Thread (Coming in the future)

This link is designed according to the URI standard, which is user-friendly for composing

![](data:image/png;base64,)

* **Host:** the host of the link
* **Path:** the path includes two parts, the first part refers to the scenario, and the second part refers to the behavior
* **Query:** the query indicates the specific page in the corresponding scenarios

# How to Use

## Link to User Profile

**Step 1**: Find your SeaTalk ID in the App through "Me -> SeaTalk Profile".

![](data:image/png;base64,)

**Step 2**: Compose the SeaTalk Link with your SeaTalk ID.

**https://link.seatalk.io/profile/open?seatalk\_id=** **<Replace with your own SeaTalk ID>**

**Step 3**: Copy and paste the link anywhere or even turn it to a button on the website to let others find you easily.

## Link to Bot Profile

**Step 1**: Log in to SeaTalk Open Platform and open your app configuration page. The SeaTalk Link of the bot is provided on the Bot configuration page.

![](data:image/png;base64,)

**Step 2**: Copy and paste the link anywhere or even turn it to a QR-Code or button on the website to let others find you easily.

## Link to a Message

*Note: Applies only to messages in group chats.*

**Step 1**: Retrieve the message ID from the API response where the message was created or accessed. For example, you may get the message ID from the response when you [send a message to a group chat.](https://open.seatalk.io/docs/Send-Message-to-Group-Chat)

Response sample:

```json
{
	"code": 200
	"message_id": "uFrIUn3uDAIRQpReXQ0G6T8fxG0duqp67smFLmG5cwU"
} Copy
```

**Step 2**: Compose the SeaTalk Link with the message ID.

**https://link.seatalk.io/message/open?message\_id=** **<Replace with the message ID>**

**Step 3**: Copy and paste the link anywhere to let others navigate to a specific message easily.
